## Introductory Page
Hi, I'm Yiran Jin. I am a first-year biostatistics graduate student interested in data analysis in public health and healthcare research.

My academic interests include public health, epidemiology, and data analysis. I enjoy learning new tools, exploring data, and finding out what the numbers have to say.

Outside of class, I'm always happy to explore new places, try good food, and learn something new.

This website is part of my P8105 coursework, where I'm learning to build a personal website and share a little about myself and my academic journey.

Thank you for stopping by!
